The '''XVIII National Population Census and VII Housing Census or Population and Housing Census 2012''' (Spanish: '''XVIII Censo Nacional de Población y VII de Vivienda''' o '''Censo de Población y Vivienda 2012)'''<ref>{{Cite web |last= |title=Presentación general |url=http://www.censo.cl/censo-2012/presentacion_general/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120113023702/http://www.censo.cl/censo-2012/presentacion_general |archive-date=2012-01-13 |access-date=2026-08-16}}</ref> was a [[Census|population census]] that was carried out in Chile between April 9 and July 15, 2012,<ref>{{Cite web |date=2012-06-22 |title=Aplicación del Censo se extenderá en las regiones de Atacama y Metropolitana |url=http://www.cooperativa.cl/aplicacion-del-censo-se-extendera-en-las-regiones-de-atacama-y-metropolitana/prontus_nots/2012-06-22/140101.html |access-date=2026-08-16 |website=Cooperativa}}</ref> and whose objective was to update the data recorded in the census carried out ten years earlier, in April 2002. Its preparation was the responsibility of the [[National Statistics Institute (Chile)|National Statistics Institute of Chile]] (INE).

The final census results were published on April 2, 2013, tallying a national total of 16,634,603 inhabitants; however, they were later removed.<ref name="rpc2012">{{Cite web |title=Resultados finales: Censo de población y vivienda 2012 |url=http://www.emol.com/noticias/nacional/2013/04/02/591330/censo-2012-poblacion-chilena-supera-los-166-millones-de-habitantes.html |access-date=2026-08-16 |website=[[EMOL]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2014-09-24 |editor-last=emol.com |title=INE retira información de Censo 2012 y realizará auditoría técnica a base de datos |url=http://www.emol.com/noticias/economia/2014/03/27/652241/ine-deshabilita-acceso-a-datos-de-censo-2012-y-realizara-auditoria-tecnica-a-base-de-datos.html |access-date=2026-08-16 |website=Economía |publisher=El Mercurio}}</ref> Finally, in September 2014, the National Institute of Statistics published a new figure based on projections from the 2002 Census, which yielded an estimated total of 17,819,054 inhabitants; The data from the 2012 census were subsequently discarded due to a series of problems in obtaining and processing the data.<ref name="inf2014">{{cite journal|author=Instituto Nacional de Estadísticas |date=24 September 2014 |title=Auditoría técnica a la base de datos del levantamiento censal año 2012 |url=http://www.ine.cl/canales/chile_estadistico/censos_poblacion_vivienda/auditoria-levantamiento-censal.pdf}}<!-- auto-translated from Spanish by Module:CS1 translator --></ref><ref name="c2012act">{{cite web|url=http://www.ine.cl/canales/chile_estadistico/demografia_y_vitales/proyecciones2014/proyecciones-de-poblacion-2014.xlsx|title=Población País y Regiones - Actualización 2002-2012 Proyección 2013-2010|access-date=2026-08-17|author=Instituto Nacional de Estadísticas (INE)|date=September 2014|publisher=www.ine.cl}}</ref>

Other countries in the Americas that conducted censuses during 2012 included [[Cuba]], [[Honduras]], [[Guyana]] and [[Paraguay]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Menchaca, Raúl |date=2010-09-06 |title=Otro censo a las puertas |url=http://www.cubahora.cu/index.php?tpl=principal/ver-noticias/ver-not_ptda.tpl.html&newsid_obj_id=1038151 |access-date=2026-08-16 |website=cubahora.cu }}{{Dead link|date=August 2026 |bot=InternetArchiveBot }}</ref>

== Background ==
In mid-2010, the INE conducted a pre-census in the commune of [[Vicuña, Chile|Vicuña]]<nowiki/>in the [[Coquimbo Region]], to implement a preliminary survey design.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Rovano, Matías |date=2010-05-31 |title=En Vicuña parten pruebas para el Censo 2012 |url=http://www.emol.com/noticias/nacional/detalle/detallenoticias.asp?idnoticia=416313 |access-date=2026-08-16 |website=EMOL}}</ref>

The census model underwent a review process between March and September 2011.<ref name="junio2010">{{Cite web |last= |date=2010-06-29 |title=Censo 2012 incluirá preguntas sobre uso de redes sociales |url=http://tele13.13.cl/noticias/tecnologia/18052.htm |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100718115917/http://tele13.13.cl/noticias/tecnologia/18052.htm |archive-date=2010-07-18 |access-date=2026-08-16 |website=Canal 13}}</ref>

== Controversies ==
=== Methodology ===
Law 17374 states that the census must be carried out in one day, and that this day must be declared a holiday, so the new mechanism was left in a dubious legal position.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Farah, Miguel |date= 19 October 2008|title=Días Feriados en Chile - Feriados en días de censos de población. |url=http://www.feriadoschilenos.cl/anexos.html#censo_de_2012 |access-date=2026-08-16 |publisher=www.feriadoschilenos.cl |language= |format=HTML |quote=}}</ref> In fact, Decree 143 of the Ministry was reviewed by the [[Comptroller General of Chile|Comptroller's]] Office, which explained this situation.<ref>{{Cite web |title=UKA001431100 |url=http://www.contraloria.cl/appinf/LegisJuri/legislacion.nsf/0/60D31C5A7301C4998425797B0063E41F?OpenDocument |access-date=2020-12-02 |website=www.contraloria.cl}}</ref>

=== Alleged manipulation of the numbers ===
On April 26, 2013, it was reported that the director of INE, [[Francisco Labbé Opazo]], allegedly manipulated the 2012 Census figures in a scandal that ended with his resignation.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Copia archivada |url=http://www.latercera.com/noticia/nacional/2013/04/680-520533-9-el-director-del-ine-habria-manipulado-las-cifras-del-censo-2012.shtml |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130430020646/http://www.latercera.com/noticia/nacional/2013/04/680-520533-9-el-director-del-ine-habria-manipulado-las-cifras-del-censo-2012.shtml |archive-date= 2013-04-30 |access-date=2026-08-16}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=S.A.P |first=El Mercurio |date=2013-04-27 |title=Director del INE deja cargo tras denuncia de manipulación en Censo {{!}} Emol.com |url=https://www.emol.com/noticias/nacional/2013/04/26/595678/sale-director-ine.html |access-date=2020-12-02 |website=Emol |language=español}}</ref>

In March 2014, it was reported that the government of Michelle Bachelet would conduct a new "abbreviated" census, a matter that was confirmed in June, and that [[2017 Chilean census|took place]] in April 2017.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2014-03-02 |title=Gobierno electo decide realizar nuevo censo, tras polémica entrega de resultados |url=http://diario.latercera.com/2014/03/02/01/contenido/pais/31-158993-9-gobierno-electo-decide-realizar-nuevo-censo-tras-polemica-entrega-de-resultados.shtml |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150503092208/http://diario.latercera.com/2014/03/02/01/contenido/pais/31-158993-9-gobierno-electo-decide-realizar-nuevo-censo-tras-polemica-entrega-de-resultados.shtml |archive-date=2015-05-03 |access-date=2026-08-16 |website=La Tercera}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2014-06-10 |title=Gobierno opta por censo abreviado en 2017 y crea un comité para supervisar proceso |url=https://www.df.cl/noticias/economia-y-politica/actualidad/gobierno-opta-por-censo-abreviado-en-2017-y-crea-un-comite-para-supervisar-proceso/2014-06-09/213656.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140714161858/https://www.df.cl/noticias/economia-y-politica/actualidad/gobierno-opta-por-censo-abreviado-en-2017-y-crea-un-comite-para-supervisar-proceso/2014-06-09/213656.html |archive-date=2014-07-14 |access-date=2026-08-16 |website=Diario Financiero}}</ref>
